items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: when we were going to get paid Mike came to us... So in Cincinnati we say well, we're not going to work... Mike, Mike McKendrick went out there and he related to Louie what our feelings were

ctx.x: work seven nights, say if you worked three nights, what is that, seven into 40, it's a little over $5.00 a night, right?

So anyway, when we got into Cincinnati, Ohio, see, we really didn't know nothing about this pro rata until we hit Cincinnati, Ohio, and when we were going to get paid Mike came to us, he said, "Well you know, now we only worked three days last week, so --." We said, "What?" So we were supposed to open at Castle Farms, that was a famous ballroom in Cincinnati --
